result.notes:
VERIFICATION STATUS: I did not verify any of these datasets by calling the TPEx endpoints myself, so every verified flag is false. Only the first two WebFetch calls to https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/swagger.json worked; they listed paths through /t187ap46_O_19 and then the response was cut off at about 55k characters. Every later call to www.tpex.org.tw failed with CLIENT_ERROR: all /openapi/v1/* data endpoints, swagger.json?v=2, /openapi/ and robots.txt. tpex.org.tw without www returned ROBOTS_DISALLOWED. Shell networking is blocked as instructed. Field names and samples therefore come from captured raw TPEx responses stored on GitHub, read with WebFetch on raw.githubusercontent.com and GitHub code search:
(a) jieyou-chyu/SwaggerAPISample docs/swagger/tpex/GET__*.json, real responses captured 2025-11-23 with HTTP headers, plus a 225-path manifest.
(b) alger68/alger68.github.io, raw rows fetched 2026-10-09T13:27Z with Date 1151008. These are copied verbatim from code-search text and are the best samples.
(c) f312213213/legislator-wealth.tw data/tpex_mainboard_quotes.json, Date 1151008.
(d) ElMooro/si, a live key dump of tpex_3insti_daily_trading on 2026-08-17.
Samples marked 'reassembled' were relayed field by field by the fetch model, so exact whitespace inside values may be lost. Re-check them on the first GitHub Actions run.

GENERAL QUIRKS
- Base URL is https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/<path>.
- No query parameters: each endpoint returns only the latest trading day, or the latest month or quarter, for the whole market. History must be accumulated by the daily job.
- Swagger also offers text/csv (Accept header), which uses Chinese column headers.
- Every value is a string. Per-stock OpenAPI JSON has no thousands commas (the website endpoints do). Convert with Number() after trim().
- Date formats:
  - ROC compact yyyMMdd ('1151008' = 2026-10-08) for quotes, peratio, margin, 3insti, t187ap03_O Date, t187ap14_O Date, tpex_reward_index and tpex_daily_trading_index.
  - Gregorian yyyyMMdd for tpex_index and for t187ap03_O DateOfIncorporation/DateOfListing.
  - ROC yyyMM ('11508') for revenue 資料年月.
  - ROC year '114' plus 季別 or Season for financials.
- Placeholders:
  - '----' for Close/Open/High/Low and '---' for Change when a stock did not trade.
  - Change may be '除息', sometimes with a trailing space.
  - Change has an explicit '+' sign. In daily_close_quotes, negative values carry a trailing space ('-0.05 ').
  - 'N/A' for P/E when a company is loss-making. '0.00000000' and '0.00' when there is no dividend.
  - '-' in 備註 when there is no remark.
  - NextLimitUp 9999.95 and NextLimitDown 0.01 for securities with no price limit.
- Text values in t187ap03_O can have trailing half-width or full-width spaces.
- Official key typos you must copy exactly: LatesAskPrice, ShortConvering, and the 3insti keys with odd spaces.
- Monthly revenue is in 仟元 and margin is in lots (張). Quote volume and 3insti values are in shares.
- Freshness: in Nov 2025 the peratio feed was still serving Jan 2025 data, so always compare each dataset's Date to the expected trading day and keep the previous file if it is stale. I could not verify the time of day TPEx publishes. A GitHub Actions project (0301kenny/wfnt-snapshot-data) polls at 17:37, 19:37 and 21:37 Taipei time, and some scrapers send a random browser User-Agent.
- 2026-10-09 was a market holiday (observed National Day), so the latest data on 2026-10-10 is 1151008.

DATASET CHOICE
- Quotes: use tpex_mainboard_quotes (round-lot volume, ETFs included) or tpex_mainboard_daily_close_quotes (adds Average and NextReferencePrice; volume includes odd lots; about 10k rows including warrants).
- ETFs: no separate ETF endpoint found.
- Industry: no official code-to-name endpoint. Prefer the 產業別 name in t187ap14_O or t187ap05_O, with SecuritiesIndustryCode from t187ap03_O plus the derived map as a fallback.
- EPS: mopsfin_t187ap14_O gives latest-quarter EPS that is cumulative year to date.
- Index: tpex_index (OHLC, Gregorian dates) or tpex_reward_index (ROC dates).

OTHER RELEVANT PATHS SEEN IN THE SWAGGER (not inspected)
/tpex_3insti_qfii (foreign holding %), /tpex_exright_prepost, /tpex_margin_sbl, /mopsfin_t187ap39_O (dividends, from the manifest), /tpex_daily_market_value.
